description: The Department for Transport publishes its 2022 national road traffic projections for England and Wales. The release contains scenario outputs for road traffic, congestion and emissions from 2025 to 2060. The forecasts use the National Transport Model with economic, demographic and travel-behaviour evidence. Scenarios represent uncertainty in future demand and differ from those in the 2018 release. Data are listed as a filterable ODS workbook and a machine-readable CSV, alongside a report. The public page provides free access under the stated Open Government Licence terms, subject to exceptions. These outputs support comparisons of demand and capacity-planning scenarios. Caveats: no data files or report were downloaded; column definitions, units, geographic subdivisions and completeness remain unchecked. The projections are model outputs, not observed traffic. This release is related to the existing National Transport Model and the separately recorded 2018 forecasts.
